item.title: UPDATE: Amazon announces 16,000 layoffs, had inadvertently sent email about the move
item.description: The tech giant's move comes three months after it laid off 14,000 workers; the company had inadvertently announced the move in an email. The post UPDATE: Amazon announces 16,000 layoffs, had inadvertently sent email about the move appeared first on HR Executive.

item.title: ICHRA enrollment nearly triples as Americans shift to ‘cash-for-coverage’ plans
item.description: Roughly 400,000 to 800,000 U.S. residents might be using cash from individual coverage health reimbursement arrangements or similar arrangements to pay for their health insurance this year. The post ICHRA enrollment nearly triples as Americans shift to ‘cash-for-coverage’ plans appeared first on HR Executive.

item.title: ADM’s blueprint for modernizing the frontline experience

item.title: HR’s image problem exposed by a viral snowstorm
item.description: A series of satirical social media posts by the police department in Louisville, Ky., highlighted a truth many HR pros already know: Employees don’t like HR. But what is the real cost of that reputation? The post HR’s image problem exposed by a viral snowstorm appeared first on HR Executive.
